Diploma Programme

Diploma in
Nursing

The Diploma in Nursing programme at DIT is accredited by MQA and MOHE. The 3-year course provides graduates with excellent career prospects in Malaysia and abroad including Singapore. DIT has a 100% passing rate record for the LJM Assistant Nurse Examinations, and offers scholarship partnerships with hospitals guaranteeing jobs upon graduation.

3 Years (Full Time) Intake: May & September

Entry Requirements

Entry Requirements

SPM with THREE (3) Credits: Bahasa Melayu, Elementary Mathematics or Additional Mathematics, Science (General / Applied / Biology / Chemistry / Physics)
Pass in English and ONE (1) other subject
OR SPM + Assistant Nurse Certificate / Community Nurse Certificate certified with Lembaga Jururawat Malaysia with THREE (3) years clinical experience

International Students

GCE O Levels or equivalent — FIVE (5) Credits including Mathematics, ONE (1) Science subject, and 3 other subjects

About This Programme

The Diploma in Nursing programme at DIT is accredited by MQA and MOHE. The 3-year course provides graduates with excellent career prospects in Malaysia and abroad including Singapore. DIT has a 100% passing rate record for the LJM Assistant Nurse Examinations, and offers scholarship partnerships with hospitals guaranteeing jobs upon graduation.

Course Modules

1Semester 1

  • Anatomy and Physiology I & II
  • Principles and Practices of Nursing
  • Microbiology, Immunology & Parasitology
  • Communications & Counselling
  • Advanced Communicative English
  • Clinical Practice I

2Semester 2

  • Principles and Practices of Nursing II
  • Fluid, Electrolyte & Acid Base Balance
  • Nursing Science – Integumentary System, Burns & Scalds
  • Personal & Professional Development, Medico Legal
  • Pengajian Islam / Pendidikan Moral
  • Clinical Practice II

3Semester 3

  • Pharmacology in Nursing
  • Anaesthesia in Nursing & Pre/Intra/Post Operative Care
  • Nursing Science – Altered Respiratory Function
  • Nursing Science – Altered Functions Genitourinary System
  • Penghayatan, Etika dan Peradaban
  • Clinical Practice III

4Semester 4

  • Nursing Science – Musculoskeletal Disorder & Trauma
  • Communicable Diseases & Epidemiology
  • Nursing Science – CNS Critical Care Nursing
  • Nursing Science – Gastrointestinal System
  • Nursing Science – Ophthalmology & ENT
  • Khidmat Masyarakat
  • Clinical Practice IV

5Semester 5

  • Community Health Nursing
  • Emergency Nursing
  • Mental Health Nursing & Gerontology Nursing
  • Nursing Science – Obstetrics Gynaecology and Paediatric
  • Research Methodology in Nursing
  • Clinical Practice V

6Semester 6

  • Management in Nursing
  • Health Sociology & Psychology
  • Integrity & Anti Corruption
  • Nursing Science – Altered Function of Reproductive System
  • Nursing Science – Altered Function of Endocrine System
  • Clinical Practice VI

Career Prospects

Registered Nurse (Malaysia & Singapore)Specialised Nursing Roles (Paediatric, ICU)Community Healthcare WorkerHome Based Patient Care

Future Education Pathways

→Diploma → Licensure Exam → State Registered Nurse
→Bridging Program (BSN / ADN)
→Advanced Degree (MSN / DNP)
